༄༅/ /dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i chos skor 'chad pa'i sngon 'gro'i spyi bshad 'phrin las rab rgyas bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ya/'dir dgyes

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i chos skor 'chad pa'i sngon 'gro'i spyi bshad 'phrin las rab rgyas bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ya/ 'dir dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i chos skor gyi spyi bshad 'chad par bya ba la don 'di dag gis bsdus pa yin te/ bka' srol rnam bzhi'i 'byung khungs nges byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor grangs kyi bsgrub bya ngos bzung ste/ /sbyor dngos rgyas bsdus sgo nas sgrub byed bshad/ /lung rigs gnyis kyis gtso bo bsgrubs byas nas/ /de nyid mngon rtogs bcu bzhi'i rtogs pa bskyed/ /rnal 'byor rnam bcus nyams su len pa'i thabs/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong zhing lam byed rnam bzhi yis/ /lam byed tshul 'di bir+wa'i man ngag yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i tshig rkang dang po'i don ni/ rje btsun chen pos dkar chag tu/ snying po don gyi kye rdor ni/ /bir+wa'i rjes 'brangs ḍom+bhi'i skor/ /yan lag med ces pad+ma'i skor/ /dam tshig rdo rje nag po'i skor/ /gtso che'i chos sna sum cu dgu /lam skor dgu ni khyad par ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gtso che'i chos sna rnams rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i bskyed rim gnad kyi zla zer du zhib tu phye nas bshad mod kyang / rje btsun gyi dkar chag dang / rnam bshad nyid kyi rjes su 'brangs nas sum cu so dgu'i grangs tshang zhing ma nor la/ gzhan nas kha skong mi dgos par rnam bshad nyid nas thon pa yin pas/ de'i tshul brjod na/ spyi sdom la/ ḍom+bhi'i skor bcu drug pad+ma'i skor dgu nag po'i skor bcu bzhi ste sum cu so dgu'o/ /de rnams kyi dang po la/ mi thub zla ba'i gzhung bdun/ ḍom+bhi'i lnga/ gzhan bzhi ste bcu drug dang po ni bskyed rim la rigs lnga char gyi sgrub thabs ston pa gur rigs bsdus kyi sgrub thabs/ 1 yab kyi sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa/ 2 dkyil chog bzang po yongs bzung / 3 yum gyi sgrub thabs/

4 gtor chog 5 rdzogs rim gtum mo'i 'grel chung / 6 de rnams kyi rgyab rten du dka' 'grel ku mu ti/ 7 rnams te bdun no/ /gnyis pa ni/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi 'od/ 8 lhan cig skyes grub/ 9 tshogs rje btsun gyi tshogs kyi 'khor lo zhes pa las gzhan mi 'byung / rnam bshad du/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'du ba sgrog pa dang bcas pa zhes gsungs kyang rgya gzhung du so sor yod cing 'og ma bsod snyoms pa pradz+nyā shrī dz+nyā nas bsdus zhes pa yod pas 'di nyid dgongs pa yin no/ kyi 'khor lo/ 10 'du ba sgrog pa/ 11 de nyid bcu pa ste/ 12 ḍom+bhi pa'i gzhung lnga/ gsum pa ni/ sku rdo rje lha dgu'i mngon rtogs phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba a la la badz+ra gyis mdzad pa/ 13 sku rdo rje dpa' bo gcig pa'i mngon rtogs dran pa gcig pa garba ri bas mdzad pa/ 14 bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs bsod snyoms sgra gcan 'dzin dpal zer/ pas mdzad pa/ 15 rin chen 'bar ba dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa 16 bzhi ste bcu drug go /pad+ma'i skor dgu la/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes/ 17 dkyil chog nas gling ma/ 18 rdzogs rim mar me'i rtse mo lta bu/ 19 tshogs 'khor dam tshig lnga pa/ 20 sbyin sreg 21 bstod pa nyi shu pa/ 22 de dag gi rgyab rten du 'grel pa pad+ma can 23 te gzhung bdun/ de'i slob ma in+t+ra bhu tis sam+bu ṭi'i 'grel pa yang dag pa'i lta ba'i dran pa'i snang ba dang / 24 gur gyi dka' 'grel zhal nas brgyud pa 25 gnyis te dgu'o/ /dam tshig rdo rje'i skor la/ lha dgu'i sgrub thabs de nyid snang ba/ 26 dkyil chog gzhung 'grel/ 27 zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa dpa' gcig 28 'dir rnam bshad las/ yab rkyang gi sgrub thabs zhes dang / yum rkyang gi sgrub thabs zhes pa las gcig dang gnyis kyi gsal kha mi 'byung yang / rje btsun nyid kyis 'di ltar bshad pa dang / rgya gzhung yang yod pas legs pa yin no/

/ phyag gnyis pa dpa' gcig 29 yum gyi sgrub thabs gnyis rnam bshad du yum gyi sgrub thabs min pa ma bshad na'ang / rje btsun nyid kyis gnyis zhes gsungs pa dang / rgya gzhung yang gnyis 'dug go 30 31 /rdzogs rim gyi gzhung / 32 tshogs 'khor/ 33 sbyin sreg 34 ro sreg 35 rab gnas/ 36 mchod rten gyi cho ga 37 gshin gyi cho ga 38 de rnams kyi rgyab rten du 'grel pa rnal 'byor rin po che'i sbyor phreng 39 ste bcu bzhi/ de ltar na sum cu so dgu'o/ /'di ni gnad kyi zla zer 'ba' zhig gi nang nas sum cu so dgu po tshang ba yin zhing / gzhan kha skong mi dgos pa'i rmad du byung ba'i legs bshad yin no/ /de dag gi sdom ni/ rigs bsdus sgrub thabs yab kyi sgrub thabs dang / /dkyil chog yongs bzung yum gyi sgrub thabs dang / /gtor chog gtum mo'i 'grel chung ku mu ti/ /de rnams mi thub zla ba'i gzhung bdun yin/ /sgrub thabs bdud rtsi 'od dang lhan skyes grub/ /tshogs 'khor 'du ba sgrog pa de nyid bcu/ /de rnams ḍom+bhi ba yi gzhung lnga yin/ /sku yi rdo rje lha dgu'i sgrub thabs dang / /mngon rtogs dran gcig bdag med sgrub pa'i thabs/ /rin chen 'bar rnams rim pa bzhin/ a la badz+ra dang / /gar+bha ri dang slob dpon bsod snyoms pa/ /dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa'i gzhung bzhi yin/ /sgrub thabs mtsho skyes dkyil chog nas gling ma/ /mar me'i rtse mo tshogs 'khor dam tshig lnga/ /sbyin sreg bstod pa 'grel pa pad+ma can/ /de rnams pad+ma'i skor gyi gzhung bdun te/ /de steng in+d+ra bhu ti'i 'grel pa dang / /gur gyi dka' 'grel zhal nas brgyud pa gnyis/ /bsnan pas pad+ma'i skor dgur 'gyur ba yin/ /lha dgu'i sgrub thabs dkyil chog gzhung 'grel dang / /zhal brgyad pa dang phyag gnyis dpa' gcig dang / /rgyun gyi sgrub thabs gnyis dang rdzogs rim gzhung / /tshogs 'khor sbyin sreg ro sreg rab gnas dang /

/rab gnas mchod rten cho ga gshin chog dang / /'grel pa rnal 'byor rin chen sbyor phreng ste/ /de rnams nag po'i skor gyi chos bcu bzhi /de phyir ḍom+bhi'i skor gyi chos bcu drug /pad+ma'i skor dgu nag po'i bcu bzhi ste/ /yongs bsdoms sum cu dgu ste 'khrul pa med/ /ces bya bar rtogs par bya'o/ /de dag ni rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la kyai rdo rje'i bka' srol bzhugs pa la/ gzhung 'grel la brten pa gsum dang / man ngag la brten pa gcig ste bzhi yod pa'i/ srol dang po gsum gyi slob dpon rjes 'brangs dang bcas pas bkral pa'i chos sna'i grangs rnams bkod pa yin la/ bka' srol phyi ma rnal 'byor dbang phyug nas rje sa chen gyi bar snyan brgyud du bzhugs pa/ rje btsun gong ma rnams kyis phyis kyi gdul bya snyan brgyud 'dzin par 'dod pa rnams kyi don dang / man ngag nyams kyis dogs par dgongs nas yig char btab pa'i rkang grangs la rgyud 'chad pa sogs kyi chos sna'i rkang grangs dang / man ngag nyams len la dgos pa'i chos sna'i rkang grangs gnyis las/ dang po la rgyud spyi dang so so la dgos pa'i chos sna bcu gsum/ rdo rje theg pa spyi dang 'di'i rnal 'byor pa la dgos pa'i chos sna bcu bzhi/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa la dgos pa'i he ru ka'i chas kyi ngos 'dzin no/ /dang po ni/ rje btsun gyis/ rgyud sde'i dum bu rnam gzhag mngon rtogs dang / /stong thun rnams kyi don bsdus bstod pa gnyis/ /bdag med bstod pa'i rnam 'grel dang bcas pa/ /kun tu dgos pa'i gzhung bdun 'thor mi bya/ /zhes so/ /rgyud so so la dgos pa ni/ rgyud don so so'i rnam 'grel don bsdus bcas/ /gang la gang dgos de de blang bya ste/ /de ltar bcu gsum legs par rab bltas nas/ /rnam par phye bas rgyud gsum shes par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ smin byed ltung ba'i rnam bshad sgrub thabs bzhi/

/rab gnas sbyin sreg tshogs kyi cho gar bcas/ /rdo rje dril bu bgrang phreng dgang blug dang / /tha ma'i cho ga mchod rten bsgrub pa ste/ /de ltar bcu bzhi dang po'i las can nas/ /brtsams te gang zag kun gyis bzung bar bya/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ lus rgyan btung ba'i snod dang gzung bya'i rdzas/ /rol mo'i cho ga bsam gtan bgo ba'i gos/ /'di dag he ru ka dpal chas drug ste/ /rnam par phye na bcu bzhir 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa man ngag nyams len la dgos pa'i chos sna ni/ gsung ngag glegs bam du bzhugs pa rnams 'di nas de dag brjod bde ba'i phyir/ tshigs bcad du byas pa ni 'di lta ste/ rdo rje'i tshig gi rnam 'grel snyeg ma dang / /gsal byed kun gzhi rgyu rgyud gdan sogs dang / /lus dkyil 'chi blu bum dbang 'da' kha ma/ /thig le'i rnal 'byor phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid dang / /bzhi pa'i 'da' kha bar do'i gdams ngag dang / /lam dbang tshad ma bzhi dang gdams ngag drug /rten 'brel lnga dang grib sel yi ge gnyis/ /thig le'i bsrung ba yig brgya'i 'don thabs dang / /rlung sbyor bha ga'i yi ge 'khor bzhi brgya/ /dbang phyug don brgyad sa phyed mngon rtogs dang / /don bsdus ma ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/ /rtsa ba nyid kyi steng du bshad bya'o/ /de dag las 'phros gud du gsungs pa'i chos/ /'khor 'das dbyer med dbang bzhi man ngag gnad/ /mchog dbang bskur tshul bskyed rim bsdus pa dang / /ril bu'i sgrub thabs yum gyi byin rlabs dang / /gegs sel bzhi dang dbang chu sgrub thabs gsum/ /rtsa ltung 'khrul spong tshogs 'khor sbyin sreg ste/ /'phros te gsungs pa'i chos sna bcu bdun las/ /phyi ma bdun po logs su bzhag kyang rung / /'bring bsdus lam gnyis gzhung shing chen po bzhi/ /rtogs bskyed chos lnga lam zab bla ma dang / /lung sbyor bzhi dang brgyud pa'i lo rgyus gnyis/

/man ngag phra mo bcas pa drug cu'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de dang tshad ma bzhi sbyar ba'i tshul ni/ go bde ba'i ngag gis brjod na/ bla ma tshad ma rgya bod rnam thar gnyis/ /nyams myong tshad ma khrid kyi gzhung shing bzhi/ /rtogs bskyed chos lnga gegs sel yi ge bzhi/ /gzhung shing dang por sbyar bya'i chos bcu gsum/ /'bring bsdus lam gnyis lam zab bla ma ste/ /nyi shu rtsa dgu nyams su blang bya'i chos/ /snyag ma gsal byed nyer gnyis don bsdus ma/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi bstan bcos tshad ma'i skor/ /lung gi tshad ma lung sbyor rnam bzhi ste/ /man ngag phra mo kun las phan 'dogs byed/ /ces so/ /yab yum gyi sgrub thabs gsum/ dbang chu/ tshogs 'khor/ sbyin sreg rtsa ltung 'khrul spong ste bdun ni man ngag dang / rgyud gnyis ka'i thun mong du dgos so/ /man ngag phra mo ni lam 'bras po ti dmar chung du bzhugs pa rnams yin pas/ de'i rnam grangs rnams tshigs bcad kyi sgo nas bstan na 'di yin te/ bla ma tshad ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang / /de yi kha skong sa bir lo rgyus so/ /nyams myong tshad ma bra ston zhu lan dang / /spyan gyi rnal 'byor aṣ+ṭa'i bzlas lung dang / /gzhi bshad bdud rtsi'i ril bu'i sgrub thabs dang / /dbang gi rab dbye sga ston springs yig dang / /maṇ+ḍal gsum dang de yi kha skong dang / /lus sbyong lus gnad yum gyi byin rlabs dang / /gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi dang tsaṇ+ṭa li/ /nyi shu rtsa dgu bar chad gsum sel dang / /nyams chung nyams chen rlung reng bcos pa dang / /gsang bdun gleng gzhi lus 'khrugs sel ba dang / /bka' rgya gsal byed 'phrin las so gnyis dang / /de yi zhal shes ngo sprod rtsa 'grel dang / /brda don rtsa 'grel de yi zin bris so/ /bstan bcos tshad ma gnad du che ba drug /rten 'brel lnga dang lam bsdus phyag rgya che/ /'khor bzhi tshogs sbyor lam bsdus bshad pa dang / /sgrub pa lung sbyin gsang bcu'i rgyas gdab pa'o/

/lung gi tshad ma lam zab rin 'byung dang / /sbas bshad gnyis dang 'khrul 'khor rtsa 'grel dang / /grub phra rtsa 'grel de yi gsal byed dang / /bir srung gsum dang de yi byin rlabs dang / /rnam 'joms bir+wa'i lugs kyi byin rlabs dang / /gzungs kyi mchan bu gsal byed de'i lag len/ /man ngag zur ba tshar gsum khug pa dang / /yig brgya'i man ngag sgo drug chos 'brel dang / /rje btsun kun dga' bzang po yab sras kyis/ /mdzad pa'i man ngag bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /bzhugs pa'i glegs bam dmar chung 'di nyid do/ /zhes pa ltar rtogs par bya'o/ /de rnams kyi bka' srol rnam bzhi'i 'byung khungs nges par bya ba'i don bshad zin nas/ spyi don gnyis pa dkyil 'khor grangs kyi bsgrub bya ngos bzung ba ni/ rgyud gsum nas bsgrub bya'i dkyil 'khor de la grangs du zhig gsungs na/ 'di la mchog bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / thun mong bsgrub pa gnyis las/ dang po mchog bsgrub pa ni/ mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa rtsa rgyud las/ /sku gsung thugs dang snying po kyai rdo rje/ /yum dang rgyu yi rdo rje 'chang ste drug /rdo rje gur las rigs rkyang rgyas pa lnga/ /rigs bsdus rgyas pa lnga dang bsdus pa lnga/ /mi bskyod he ru ka gsum yum gyi gnyis/ /dngos bstan nyi shu yod kyang man ngag gi /rigs gzhan bzhi la'ang sku gsung thugs sbyar bas/ /rigs lnga re re'ang bzhi bzhi nyi shu ste/ /rigs rkyang rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor nyi shu dang / /rigs bsdus rgyas bsdus nyi shu nyi shu la/ /yum gyi dkyil 'khor gnyis bstan drug cu gnyis/ /yang na rigs bsdus rgyas bsdus gnyis yod ltar/ /rigs rkyang la yang rgyas bsdus gnyis sbyar bas/ /brgyad cu rtsa gnyis 'byung ba gur rgyan lugs/ /kha sbyor rgyud las dgyes pa rdo rje bzhi/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro rdo rje bdag med ma/ /rdo rje dbyings dang drag po gdan bcas te/

/dngos su bstan pa'i dkyil 'khor brgyad 'byung la/ /rdo rje dbyings la gtso bo 'pho ba yi/ /gnad kyi rigs bsdus lnga ste bcu gnyis so/ /zhes dang / de ltar man ngag lugs kyi gsung bgros ni/ /gtsor byas dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud gsum nas/ /bshad pa'i mchog bsgrub dkyil 'khor brgya phrag gcig /'byung ba 'di ni 'khrul zad gong ma'i lugs/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa thun mong sgrub pa ni/ gzhung 'grel ltar na rtsa bshad gsum ka nas/ /'byung ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor rnams/ /dang po'i las pas bsgom bya'i rnal 'byor re/ /thun mong bsgrub pa tsam du bzhed pa'ang yod/ /las rgyas sgrub pa'i lha yi rnal 'byor ni/ /rnal 'byor gang la rnam dag ma gsungs pas/ /tha mal snang zhen rtog pa mi sbyong yang / /zhi rgyas la sogs bsgrub pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor/ /nyid yin rtsa ba'i rgyud las rdo rje ma/ /dkar mo chu ma rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /bdag med ma dang mkha' spyod sa spyod ma/ /rig byed ma ste rnam pa brgyad yod do/ /gur las 'byung po 'dul ba stobs po che/ /khro bcu so so rdo rje sgrol ma dang / /sher phyin dkar mo dang ni khro bcu spyi/ /rdo rje lus med ku ru kul+le dang / /'jig rten dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs gshin rje gshed/ /hūm̐ mdzad sgrol ma 'od zer can tsun+da/ /nor rgyun ma dang smugs 'dzin so 'brangs dang / /nag po chen po dang bcas nyi shu brgyad/ /kha sbyor rgyud las sgrol ma rig byed ma/ /shes phyin dkar mo rigs bzhi yum bzhi dang / /mchog bsgrub sgrol ma 'jigs byed 'od zer can/ /ri khrod lo ma can dang bde mchog dang / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro gshin rje gshed rta mgrin/ /mi g.yo ba dang stobs chen rnam snang dang / /mkha' lding dbang gi sgrol ma dpal mchog dang / /ku ru kul+le nyi zla bzung ba dang / /sde zhig pa dang lha dgas char dbab bcad/

/ye shes mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor nam mkha' ste/ /thun mong sgrub pa gtsor gyur sum cu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /spyi don gsum pa sbyor dngos rgyas bsdus sgo nas sgrub byed bshad pa ni gong du bshad pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor de dag sgrub par byed pa'i mngon rtogs ji ltar yin zhe na/ 'di la sngon 'gro /dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po la rgyas pa/ 'bring po/ bsdus pa gsum gyis/ dang po bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa'o/ /bsod nams tshogs bsag la yang nang gses kyis dbye na/ bsdus pa tshad med bzhi/ de bas cung zad rgyas pa tshogs zhing spyan drangs nas mchod pa/ de bas rgyas pa yan lag bdun pa/ de bas rgyas pa rigs lnga'i sdom bzung ste tshang ma bya ba rgyas pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'bring po ni/ srung 'khor mi sgom par tshogs gnyis bsag pa rgyas par bya'o/ /gsum pa bsdus pa ni/ bsod nams tshogs bsag tshad med bzhi tsam la bsdus nas/ ye shes tshogs bsag la 'jug pa'o/ /sngon 'gro bsdus pa 'di/ las rgyas bsgrub pa la bya'i/ mchog bsgrub pa la mi 'jug pa slob dpon rin po ches gsungs la/ rje btsun gyis 'jug par gsungs so/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum ste/ bskyed chog yongs su rdzogs pa rgyas pa dang / 'bring dang / bsdus pa'o/ /dang po la/ 'ching byed kyi mngon rtogs ngos bzung ba/ de rgyud gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gang la sbyor ba'o/ /dang po la sam+bu ḍi dang / rdo rje rtse mo'i dgongs pa ltar ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis 'ching ba/ rdo rje gur gyi dgongs pa ltar yan lag drug gis 'ching ba/ rtsa rgyud gsang 'dus kyi dgongs pa ltar bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhis 'ching ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gtso bor bskyed pa dang po sbyor ba dang / /mchod rten yan chad dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ste/ /phra thig la sogs lhag ma las rgyal mchog /sku gsum lam byed ting 'dzin gsum gyi 'ching /

/zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhal med khang bskyed rnam par snang mdzad sku/ /rjes chags rdor sems ngo bo sgrub thabs gtso/ /sems nyid dag byed dbang bskur mi bskyod thugs/ /bdud rtsi mgrin par myang phyir dpag med gsung / /mchod pa sangs rgyas 'phrin las don yod grub/ /bstod pa yon tan ngo bo rin chen 'byung / /rgyal ba rigs drug sgrub thabs yan lag drug /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ lha skyed bsnyen pa'i yan lag sku rdo rje/ /byin rlabs nyer sgrub yan lag gsung rdo rje/ /dgug gzhug sgrub pa'i yan lag thugs rdo rje/ /rgyas 'debs sgrub chen ye shes rdo rje bzhi/ /'di ni sgrub thabs kun la khyab byed do/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar legs par rtogs par bya'o/ /de yang sam+bhu ṭi'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lnga ni/ ting nge 'dzin gsum dang / yan lag bzhis 'ching / gur rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor rnams bskyed chog gsum char gyis 'ching / rigs rkyang rnams dang / bdag med ma gnyis/ rtsa rgyud kyi drug ni/ yan lag bzhi drug gnyis char gyis 'ching / sam+bu ṭi'i lhag ma rnams dang / las rgyas kyi lha rnams ni yan lag bzhis 'ching zhing / mchod bstod sogs ni yan lag yin gyis/ dngos gzhir mi byed do/ /gnyis pa 'bring po la/ ting nge 'dzin gsum dang / yan lag drug gis 'ching ba ni med la/ sngar gyi yan lag bzhis 'ching na/ mchod bstod sogs med par bzlas pa la 'jug pa nyid do/ /des na drug pa la 'bring por bshad pa ni bskyed chog gi dbang du byas la/ 'di rgyas par bshad na ni dngos gzhi 'ching rgyas pa'i dbang du byas pa yin no/ /gsum pa bsdus pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag skye mched byin rlabs sam/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa nyer sgrub kyi yan lag ye shes pa gzhug pa sgrub pa'i yan lag

dbang mi bskur bar dbu rgyan rang chas su bsam pa sgrub chen gyi yan lag go /bsdus pa gnyis pa ni/ dam tshig sems dpa' dbu rgyan rang chas can du skad cig gis bskyed nas bzlas pa la 'jug pa nyid do/ /de lta bu'i dngos gzhi la dam tshig pa bskyed pa'i cho ga la mngon byang las bskyed pa/ rdo rje cho ga gsum mam bzhir bskyed pa/ snying po tshig tsam las bskyed pa/ dbugs kyi spro bsdu las bskyed pa/ 'byin pa'i tshul gyis las bskyed pa dang tshul mi 'dra ba lnga yod do/ /gsum pa rjes kyi yan lag la bzlas pa dang / spyod lam la sogs pa bdun ni kun gyi thun mong ba yin la/ mchog sgrub pa la dag pa dran pa khyad par gyi chos su bzhed do/ /de rnams kyis dkyil 'khor grangs kyis sgrub bya ngos bzung ba bshad zin nas/ spyi don bzhi pa lung rigs gnyis kyis gtso bor bsgrub par bya ba ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ bdag med rnal 'byor ldan pa'am/ /yang na he ru ka dpal brtson/ /gzhan pa'i sems kyis skad cig kyang / /dngos grub 'dod pa'i mi gnas so/ /zhes gsungs shing / de'i don rig pas bsgrub pa ni/ gsang sngags pa 'bras bu lam du byed pa'i skabs yin pas/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku ni stong pa nyid dang snying rje gnyis su med pa yin la/ de lta bu'i sku'i yon tan phyogs re tsam thabs kyis rnal 'byor gzhan dang / shes rab kyi rnal 'byor gzhan gyis mtshon nus kyang / yongs su rdzogs pa gzugs kyi sku'i rnam pas mtshon nus pa ni rgyud 'di'i lugs kyi zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ yab yum kho na yin pa'i phyir gtso bor byed ces pa'i don to/ /'o na rgyu 'bras kyi he ru ka gnyis las gang gtso zhe na/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid gtso ste/ ku mu ti las/ 'bras bu 'dzin pa kyai rdo rje/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don to/ /kyai rdo rje de la yang du ma yod pas/ de rnams kyi nang nas mi bskyod pa'i rigs gtso bo yin te/

rtsa rgyud las/ rdo rje'i bu mo 'di khyer nas/ /spyod pa bya bar rtogs par bya/ /zhes dang / zhe sdang rnam dag rnal 'byor pa/ /zhes gsungs pa la/ de'i don rigs pas kyang grub ste/ sbyang gzhi chos nyid rnam par nges pa'i phung por 'dus pa dang / de sbyong byed kyi lam thams cad kyang thabs shes gnyis su med pa mi bskyod pa kyai rdo rje'i ngo bor 'dus pa dang / sbyangs 'bras ye shes thams cad kyang chos dbyings ye shes su 'dus pas na/ mi bskyod pa kyai rdo rje rigs thams cad 'dus pa'i gtso bor grub pa'o/ /sam+bu ṭar rgyud rang rkang gi nyams len gyi dbang du byas na rdo rje dbyings gtso bor gsungs kyang / bstan gnyis kyi bshad rgyud du sbyar ba'i tshe kyai rdo rje gtso bor bstan pa yin no/ /de rnams kyis lung rigs gnyis kyis gtso bor bsgrub pa bshad zin nas/ spyi don lnga pa de nyid mngon rtogs bcu bzhi'i rtogs pa bskyed pa ni/ mngon rtogs bcu bzhi'i ngo bo ngos gzung ba/ de rnams gang zag bzhis so sor ji ltar nyams su len tshul bstan pa'o/ /dang po rgyas pa yan lag bzhi pa'i phyogs la ā l̥ kā l̥ la ltos pa'i mi mnyam sbyor dang / mnyam sbyor gnyis/ ā l̥ kā l̥ spangs pa'i mi mnyam sbyor dang gsum/ de re re la 'khor gyi lha mo spro tshul thig le 'gros dang / sa bon 'gros gnyis gnyis sbyar bas drug tu 'gyur la/ 'di'i mnyam sbyor la/ gtso bo mnyam sbyor dang / 'khor mi mnyam sbyor zhes kyang 'dod do/ /'bring po yan lag drug pa la yang / ā l̥ kā l̥ la ltos pa'i mi mnyam sbyor dang / mnyam sbyor gnyis/ ā l̥ kā l̥ spangs pa'i mi mnyam sbyor dang gsum po re re la yang 'khor gyi lha mo spro tshul/ 'khor thig le las sa bon du gyur nas spro ba dang / thig le sa bon dang bcas pa lha mor gyur nas spro ba'i tshul gnyis gnyis sbyar bas drug ste thams cad bsdoms pas bcu gnyis su 'gyur la/

'di la/ bzhi gsum bcu gnyis bla mas bzhed/ /ces pa'i don yang tshang ba yin no/ /de ltar bcu gnyis kyi steng du/ sa bon las bskyed pa dang / skad cig gis bskyed pa gnyis bsnan pas bcu bzhi yin no/ /de yang mngon byang gi phyogs la yan lag bzhi pas bcings pa'i mngon rtogs drug la/ rgyu'i he ru ka 'khor bcas mngon byang kho na las bskyed par nges/ mkha' nang nas lha mo mi spro bar nges/ lha la dri za mi 'jug par nges pa ste gsum yod la/ yan lag drug pas bcings pa'i mngon rtogs drug la/ rgyu rdo rje 'chang nag por mi bskyed par nges/ lha mo brgyad 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa dang bcas pa mngon byang las mi bskyed par nges/ mkha' nang nas thig le mi spro bar nges/ lha la dri za 'jug par nges pa ste nges pa bzhi'o/ /'o na mi mnyam sbyor dang / mnyam sbyor zhes pa'i don gang yin zhe na/ mi mnyam sbyor ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ ā l̥ zla ba'i gzugs kyis gnas/ /kā l̥'i gzugs kyis snang byed do/ /zla ba nyi ma 'dus pa las/ /dkar mo la sogs rab tu bsgrags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mngon byang dang po gnyis kyi bar du mngon byang gsum pas chod pas na mi mnyam sbyor zhes bya'o/ /mnyam sbyor ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ ā l̥ kā l̥ mnyam sbyor ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyi gdan/ /yi ge las byung gong bu la/ /hūm̐ phaṭ rnam pa'ang 'dod mi bya/ /sems dpa'i gzugs brnyan las byung ba/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po rnam par sgom/ /phyag mtshan zhal sogs gong ma bzhin/ /zla ba chu shel nor bu'i 'od/ /ces gsung pa ltar mngon byang dang po gnyis mnyam par sbyar zhing / mngon byang gsum pa de'i steng du sgom pas na mnyam sbyor zhes bya'o/ /de gnyis kyi khyad par ji lta bu zhe na/ mi mnyam sbyor la nges pa drug dang / ma nges pa gnyis yod de/ nges pa drug ni/ mngon byang dang po gnyis zla nyi ya ma zung du nges/ dbyibs zlum por nges/

de la ā l̥ kā l̥s ma mtshan par nges/ mngon byang gsum pa zla nyi'i bar du yod par nges/ de la sa bon gyis mtshan par nges/ 'od zer mi spro bar nges so/ /ma nges pa gnyis ni/ mngon byang dang po gnyis rgyu ā l̥ kā l̥ la ltos par ma nges/ de las byung ba'i lha dkar nag gang du'ang ma nges so/ /mnyam sbyor rnams la nges pa brgyad yod de/ mngon byang dang po gnyis rgyu ā l̥ kā l̥ la ltos par nges/ de gnyis zla bar nges/ de gnyis dbyibs gru gsum du nges/ de la ā l̥ kā l̥s mtshan par nges/ mngon byang gsum pa bar du mi sgom par steng du sgom par nges/ de la sa bon gyis ma mtshan par nges/ de las 'od zer 'phro bar nges/ de las byung ba'i lha dkar por nges so/ /gnyis pa de rnams gang zag bzhis nyams su len tshul la/ las dang po pa'i gang zag gi nyams su blang bya'i mngon rtogs ni/ ā l̥ kā l̥ la ltos pa'i mi mnyam sbyor dang / mnyam sbyor yin la/ gang zag des mngon rtogs te thun bzhi bsgoms pas du ba la sogs pa'i rtags mnyam rjes gang rung la mthong ba'i tshe/ gang zag de bde ba cung zad skyes pa'i gang zag tu na 'pho la/ de'i bsgom bya ā l̥ kā l̥ la ma ltos pa'i mi mnyam sbyor yin cing / de ltar bsgoms pas rlung sems kyi 'phro 'du 'phel bas/ tshogs gnyis kyi dus su bde stong dngos gzhi'i skabs su bde stong zung du chud pa la sogs pa skyes pa'i tshe/ de bde stong gi nyams skyes pa'i gang zag tu 'pho ba yin la/ de'i bsgom bya ni sa bon las bskyed pa'o/ /de ltar bsgoms pas lha'i snang bas kyang rdzogs rim shas che ba la sogs pa byung ba na/ de bde stong gi nyams cher skyes pa'i gang zag tu na 'pho la/ de'i bsgom bya ni skad cig gis bskyed pa yin la/ de ltar bsgoms pas goms pa'i stobs kyis skad cig tsam la lha'i 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs par sgom nus shing /

snang ba lha'i 'khor lor shar/ lus rtsa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ dngos grub thob ces ming thob pa la sogs pa 'byung ngo / /mngon rtogs bzhi po 'di nyid gang zag blo gros rab/ 'bring / mtha' ltag tha ma bzhi dang sbyar ba dang / yang mngon rtogs phri bskyed sbyar tshul dang / bco lnga pa 'grel pa lugs kyi 'khrugs can dang / man ngag lugs la yang de dang 'dra bar byas pa dang / bdag med ma dang / lus dkyil sgom pa'i rten skad cig gis skyed pa ste bzhi po gang rung zhig bgrang bar bya zhing / de rnams kyi mtha' dpyad rgyas pa rnam bshad rnams la blta rtog zhib mo'i blos legs par dpyad par bya'o/ /spyi don drug pa rnal 'byor rnam bcu'i nyams su len pa'i tshul la/ gang zag dus dang gnas dang bsam pa dang / /sgom pa'i rnal 'byor dngos dang rnam lnga'o/ /zhes pa ltar las/ dang po gang zag gang gis bsgom na/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i lam gyis rgyud sbyangs shing / kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas dbang bskur ba thob pa dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i gang zag rang dang gzhan gyi don du mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'dod pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas 'og nas 'byung ba'i lam rim gnyis bsgom pa yin te/ slob dpon nag po pas/ dang por re zhig sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs kyi gnod pas skyo bar gyur pa'i sems can gyi khams la dmigs pa snying rje phugs su byung ba'i ros gang ba'i dbang du gyur pa'i sems kyis/ sogs dang sgrub thabs mtsho skyes las/ rnal 'byor pas sems can thams cad kyi don la brtson pa'i blos/ zhes bshad do/ /gnyis pa sgom pa'i dus ni/ las dang po pas bsam gtan sgom pa'i dus ni bying rgod kyi dbang gis rnam rtog gi 'phro 'du nyung ba'i rten 'brel yin pas/ mtshan mo'i dus khyad par du 'phags te/ rtsa rgyud las/ mtshan dus su/ zhes gsungs so/ 'o na shan+ti pa dang /

nyin 'byung zla bas/ nangs par snga bar lang la/ zhes dang / nag po pa dang / mar me mdzad kyis tho rangs lang la/ zhes bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ de bshad bde ba'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ 'dir las dang po pa bskyed rim la sems 'dzin pa'i thog mar nges par mtshan mo'i dus nas bsgom pa yin te/ shan+ti pas/ mtshan mo'i dus la zhes pa ni skye bo rnams nyal ba'i dus su'o/ /zhes dang / nag po pa'i 'grel par/ mtshan mo zhes bya ba ni/ mtshan mo'i cha la ste/ gzhan du mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyis 'tshe ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / bha wa pas/ mtshan dus su/ zhes pa ni mtshan mo nyid la dngos grub mang bar 'gyur bas so/ /zhes dang / sems cung zad brtan nas thun bzhi'i tshul gyis bsgom ste/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes las/ de ltar thun tshod bzhi rim pas/ /zhes dang / de'i 'grel par dza lan+dha ri pas/ thun bzhir byin rlabs pa'i rim pas zhes pa ni/ tho rangs dang / nyi ma'i gung dang / phyi dro dang / mtshan mo ste sgom pa'i rim pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rtsa rgyud du thun gsum gsungs pa ni/ nag po pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang mthun par/ tho rangs dang nyi mo'i thun dang / phyi dro'i thun te gsum bshad pa dang mthun la/ de dag kyang gang zag gi nus mi nus kyi bye brag dang bstun pas 'gal ba med do/ /gsum pa la gnas dngos dang / der spyod lam ji ltar du sgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ las dang po pas rnal 'byor sgom pa'i gnas ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ dang po goms par byed dus kyi/ /gnas ni gang du bsngags pa'i sems/ /gcig tu mnyam gzhag 'grub 'gyur ba'i/ /gnas ni bzang po nges par brtag /rang gi khyim du/ zhes gsungs so/ /sems cung zad brtan pas dur khrod sogs su sgom par bshad do/ /rtsa rgyud las/ dur khrod ri yi bya skyabs dang / /zhes sogs so/ /brtan pa cher thob pa'i gnas ni/ rnal 'byor pa'i ngos nas/ rtsa rgyud las/ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang /

/ma mo'i khyim dang mtshan mo dang / /yang na dben pa'i bas mtha' ru/ /bsgom pa bzang bar brjod par bya/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /sgom bya'i lha'i ngos nas bshad na/ dur khrod/ chu 'gram/ shing drung / nags tshal/ khang stong sogs su bya bar gsungs te/ rdo rje gur las/ snying rje chen po kyai rdo rje/ /nga ni dur khrod chu 'gram dang / /nags tshal skye bo med grong du/ /bsnyen bkur can la dngos grub ster/ /mtsho skyes rnam pa'i 'gram yid 'ong / /sku gdung zab mo'i mchod rten dang / /rkang 'thung rlon pa'i 'og tu ni/ /nga ni sangs rgyas dngos grub ster/ /tshong 'dus grong brdal nyid dang ni/ /yang dog rnam pa'i khyim du ni/ /rdo rje nyi ma brtan pa nga / /bsnyen bkur can la dngos grub ster/ /glu gar rab tu 'ching ba dang / /chang 'tshong ma yi khyim du ni/ /'di ltar pad+ma gar mkhan ngas/ /bsnyen bkur can la dngos grub ster/ /rtag tu mgyogs 'gro bzhon gyur te/ /res 'ga' lam du 'gro ba na/ /rta ni don yod bstan pa ngas/ /dngos grub rdo rje rnams ster ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnas de dag las dang po pas bsam gtan sgom pa'i gnas su'ang rung ste/ dpal ldan rtse mo zhabs kyis/ gnas 'ga' zhig tu gnas na nad gzhi mi skye/ kha cig tu gdon gyi bar chad mi 'byung / kha cig tu ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'gyur ba ni yid du 'ong ba ste shis pa'i gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /yang rtse mo zhabs kyis khyad par dur khrod smos pa ni/ las dang po pas brtson 'grus myur du rtsom par 'gyur pa dang / khyad par du bsngags pa'i gnas te/ zhes gsungs la/ brtan pa cher thob pa'i gnas la nges pa med do/ /gnyis pa spyod lam ji ltar sgom pa ni/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su sgrub pa po rab byung min par khyim pa yin na/ dngos kyi rig ma'am ye shes kyi'ang rung la/ tshangs spyod kyi rten can yin na/ ye shes kyi rig ma bsam pa dang bcas pas bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa'i dam tshig gi rdzas bsten pa/

mchod pa dang gtor ma bya bar sgrub thabs mtsho skyes las gsungs pa ltar/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras dang / de'i rgyud pa 'dzin pa rnams maṇ+ḍal mchod chog rgyas par mdzad pa la/ maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod ces kyang bya/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba zhes kyang bya/ mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor zhes kyang bya/ phyi rol tshogs bsog gi rnal 'byor zhes kyang bya'o/ /bzhi pa bsam pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /'di yi las rnams thams cad byed/ /ces pa ltar/ 'grub mi 'grub snyam pa'i dogs pa'am/ bar chad dang gnod pa 'byung snyam pa'i 'jigs pa'i sems med par dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba la sogs pa'i nges 'byung gis rgyud bskul nas/ thabs shes kyi lam khyad par can gyis bsam gtan bsgom par bya ste/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu g.yo ba dang / /'jig rten skye bo dam pa 'phrad rnyed dka'/ /de bas shes rab thabs la gzhol ba yis/ /yid la byed pa'i mchog de bsgrub par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /lnga pa bsgom bya'i rnal 'byor dngos ni/ rje sa skya pa chen pos/ 'dir ni mngon rtogs rnam gnyis te/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang / /mnyam par ma bzhag rnal 'byor ro/ /mnyam gzhag bskyed rdzogs rnam gnyis te/ /mnyam par ma bzhag pa la brgyad/ /nyal dang ldang dang bzlas pa dang / /khrus dang kha zas gtor ma dang / /spyod lam rjes chags rnal 'byor brgyad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ go rim de ltar bshad kyang / nyams len gyi tshe dang po nyal ba'i rnal 'byor nas brtsams te nyams su len par shes par bya'o/ /spyi don bdun pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprad cing / lam byed rnam pa gzhis lam du byed pa'i tshul ni mi g.yo ba rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud las/ 'chi ba nyid ni chos su brjod/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa bar srid dang / /'gro ba gzugs drug sprul pa'i sku/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod bde chen po/

/zhes gsungs pa ltar sgrub thabs yongs rdzogs la sbyar na/ ye shes tshogs bsag gis sbyang gzhi 'chi ba sbyong zhing / 'bras bu chos sku lam du byed do/ /rkyen gyi yan lag la sogs pa rnams kyis sbyang gzhi bar srid sbyong zhing / 'bras bu longs sku lam du byed do/ /rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa zhal phyag gi rnam pa can yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa dang / 'khor gyi lha mo mngal nas dbyung ba dang / 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa la sogs pas sbyang gzhi skye ba len pa sbyong / 'bras bu sprul sku lam du byed do/ mchod bstod bdud rtsi myangs pas ni/ sbyang gzhi 'dod yon la longs spyod pa sbyong zhing / 'bras bu bde ba chen po'i sku lam du byed do/ /yang lha'i bskyed chog kho na la sbyar nas nyams su len na/ mngon byang dang po bzhis chos sku /rdo rje 'dzin pas longs sku /'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa thig le'i gong bu las bzhengs pa dang / 'khor gyi lha mo spro ba yan chad kyis sprul sku lam du byed pa ste/ de yang mngon par dbang bskur ba byas pas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal srid la mnga' gsol zhing rab tu gnas pa dang / mchod cing bstod la bdud rtsi myang ba byas pas/ lhar bcas 'jig rten 'gro bas mchod cing bkur bsti'i gnas su gyur pa dang / bzlas pas tha mal gyi ngag sbyong zhing chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad pa bskor ba lam du byed/ dkyil 'khor bsdu bas 'chi ba sbyong zhing / gzugs sku chos kyi dbyings su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa lam du byed/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ tha mal gyi lus ngag yid gsum bya byed thams cad sbyangs nas/ slar yang 'khor ba ji srid par mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad par lam du byed do/ /yang lha'i rnam pas dus gsum sbyong ba ni/ gdul bya'i zhe sdang 'dul ba'i phyir khro bor sgom pa dang / 'dod chags 'dul ba'i phyir btsun mo dang zhal sbyor dang /

btsun mo'i 'khor gyis bskor ba dang / gti mug 'dul ba'i phyir 'dzum zhing zhi pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan par sgom pa dang / rigs 'dra gnyen por che ba dang / ldog pa gnyen por che ba dang / sbam pa gnyen por che ba dang / bsnan pa gnyen por che ba rnams lung cung zad dang sbyar na/ mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog lhun grub kyi gsung rab las/ lha sku khro chags can sgom zhe sdang dang / /btsun mo'i 'khor gyis yongs bskor 'dod chags dang / /mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i skur sgom gti mug sbyong / /zhes dang / brtan pa'i dug gis g.yo ba'i dug 'joms ltar/ /tha mal rnam rtog lam gyi rtog pas 'joms/ /rlung nad chung ngu mon sran gyis zlog ltar/ /snod bcud gnyen por bskyed rim sgom pas zlog /chu nyung mang po'i grogs kyis 'gugs pa ltar/ /bzhin lag gcig zhen gnyen por du ma sgom/ /tshig pa bsreg bcad sogs kyis 'chos pa ltar/ /'dod chags gnyen por lha mo'i 'khor sgom sogs/ /zhes dang / rtsa rgyud las kyang dug gi dum bu gang nyid kyis/ /skye bo thams cad 'chi bar 'gyur/ /dug gi de nyid shes pa des/ /dug gis dug ni 'bigs par byed/ /ci ltar rlung gis zin pa des/ /mon sran rnge'us za ba sbyin/ /zlog pa'i sman ni brtags pa las/ /rlung gis rlung la snun par byed/ /rnam rtog las ni rnam rtog dang / /srid pa nyid kyis srid pa 'dag /ji ltar rna bar chu zhugs pa/ /chu gzhan gyis ni dgug par bya/ /de bzhin dngos po'i rnam rtog kyang / /rnam par nges pas sbyang bar bya/ /ji ltar 'tshed pas tshig pa yang / /me yis yang ni gdung bar bya/ /de bzhin 'dod chags mes tshig pa/ /'dod chags me yis gdung bar bya/ /skye bo mi zad pa yi las/ /gang dang gang gis 'ching 'gyur ba/ /thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyis/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur/ /chags pas 'jig rten 'ching 'gyur ba/

/'dod chags nyid kyis rnam grol 'gyur/ /zlog pa'i sgom pa de nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas mu stegs kyis mi shes/ /zhes sogs lung dang rnam dbye rgyas par spro na/ mngon rtogs ljon shing dang / rnam bshad dag ldan sogs gong ma'i gsung rab rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa las rtogs par byas na blo gros dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed ngo sprad pa de nyid lam byed rnam pa bzhis lam du byed pa'i tshul ni/ sngar bshad pa'i sbyang gzhi dang / sbyong byed de dag thams cad kyang / 'dra chos dang mtshon don rtogs pa rang dga' bas bsgrigs pa tsam ma yin gyis/ sems kun gzhi'i steng du mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyi bag chags gnas pa'i stobs kyis/ kun rdzob kyi snang ba thams cad 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa'i gzugs sku dang chos sku'i rnam pa rang bzhin rnam dag gi tshul gyis 'byung ba yin par ni/ rtsa rgyud phyi ma'i bcu gcig par/ lus can thams cad kha dog dang dbyibs kyi sgo nas rigs lngar nges tshul gsungs pas shes la/ de'i phyir bsgoms pas glo bur gyi dri ma dag ste mngon du gyur pa ni sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed mtshon don bsgrigs pa'i don no/ /des na 'di la sbyang gzhi thams cad lam de dang der sgom pa'i tshul dang / de nyid lam byed bzhi'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni mtshan gzhi gcig la sbyar na/ mngal skyes kyi ma'i phyag rgya gru gsum dang / sgong skyes kyi sgo nga sogs bzhi po ma dag pa'i phyag rgya sogs ma yin gyis/ bdag gi blo la snang ba'i chos 'byung gru gsum 'di yin no snyam du dbyer med du sgom mo/ /gnyis pa gnyis/ de ltar chos 'byung gru gsum sgom pas rnam pa gzugs kyi rnam pa sgom sla bas rnam pa lam du byed pa zhes bya/ de nyid rnam thar sgo gsum dang / spyan la sogs pa'i phyag rgyar mos pa byas pas/ mos pa lam du byed pa zhes bya/

de yang sangs rgyas pa'i 'bras bu rnam thar sgo gsum dang / spyan la sogs pa phyag rgya dngos yin par sgom pas/ 'bras bu lam du byed pa zhes bya/ des rnal 'byor pas sems rgyud byin gyis brlabs shing / tshogs rdzogs pas byin rlabs lam du byed pa zhes bya ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang zhen pas 'jug cing 'brel pas mi bslu ba'i lam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de la zhen pas 'jug pa ni/ sbyang gzhi la rnam par zhen nas/ rnam pa la 'bras bu dngos su zhen pa'o/ /'brel bas mi bslu ba ni sbyang gzhi dang / lam dang 'bras bu gsum char yang gcig la gcig 'brel ba'am/ don la dbyer med pas mi bslu ba ste/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i sbyang gzhi dang / sbyong byed bsgoms pas sangs rgyas pa'i chos thams cad thob pa'i rgyu mtshan yang 'di nyid yin no/ /de ltar rnal 'byor bcu po sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyar zhing lam byed bzhi ldan du brtson pa drag pos bsgoms pas drod chung ngu thob pa na/ kun dhar gsang nas spyod/ des drod 'bring po thob pa na/ kun dhar 'jig rten pa'i mngon du spyod/ des lung bstan pa'i bu mo pad+ma can bsten nas drod chen po thob pa na/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pas zla ba gcig gis sa brgyad pa thob ste/ nye rgyu spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par 'gyur zhing / de nas nye rgyu zhag bdun gyis rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sa bcu gsum pa thob par 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o// //'dir smras pa/ sa skya'i yab chos dgyes rdor spyi bshad 'di/ /sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang chen po ru/ /sa skya'i zab chos lam 'bras 'chad pa'i tshe/ /sa skya'i rig 'dzin ngag dbang kun dgas sbyar/ /bsod nams 'di yis bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /bstan pa cher rgyas don gnyis mthar phyin te/ /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /'di ni gong ma'i gsung rab don bsdus te/

/'di ni legs bshad spel ba'i rtsa ba'ang yin/ /'di ni don bsdus rgyas bshad gnyis ldan pa'i/ /'di ni sngon med legs bshad ngo mtshar yin/ /e ma mang du thos pa'i lus stobs can/ /rnam dpyod mche sder bsod nams ral pas brjid/ /de 'dra'i sngags 'chang ri dwags rgyal po de/ /da ltar dpal ldan sa skya'i gangs rir gnas/ /tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i skal bzang kun 'dus nas/ /tshogs gnyis spel ba'i 'phrin las rgya mtsho la/ /tshogs gnyis bsags rnams gcig tu brtson pa 'dis/ /tshogs gnyis rab rgyas don gnyis lhun grub shog /ces pa 'di yang khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po dang / rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can dang / khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ shing mo glang gi lo rnal 'byor dbang phyug brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi sa gsum gyi bla ma chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i bzhugs khri pad+ma can ga la ba der 'khod nas skal ldan 'dus pa rgya mtsho la gsung ngag rin po che zab rgyas kyi chos kyi char phab pa'i tshe rang gzhan gyi don du myur bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni maṅga la'i ming can gyis bgyis so/ /'di la nyes pa'i tshogs mchis na bla ma dang mkha' 'gros bzod par mdzad nas bstan pa dang / 'gro ba la phan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung bar mdzad du gsol// //sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i chos skor 'chad pa'i sngon 'gro'i spyi bshad 'phrin las rab rgyas/
